COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPPIL No.135 of 2015
Sh r i San j ay a Ku m ar Mish r a, ACJ.
Sh r i Ram esh Ch an d r a Kh u lbe, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
Mr. J.C. Pandey, learned Standing
Counsel for the State.
This writ-petition was disposed of on
13.06.2018. I t is further apparent from
the record that initially when the m atter
was taken up by virtue of order dated
13.06.2018 Mr. Senthil Pandian, I AS was
appointed as one m an com m ission to
inquire into the allegations m ade by the
petitioner. He m ade inquiry and subm itted
his report on 17.05.2019. The conclusion
of the report is: -
"1.The related case is of the year 2012-13 and
2013-14, terrestrial investigation of which is not
possible at present. No photographs of the damage
caused on dated 3/ 4-08-2012 and 16/ 17-06-2013
available. I f the photographs were taken, so the
situation could have been predicted. Due to absence of
the photographs and long duration of disaster, it is
possible to check only on the basis of available records.
I n view of this, the inquiry was done on the basis of the
discussion m ade at the tim e of investigation and the
records m ade available by the Tehsildar and District
Magistrate, Badhkot, Dunda and Bhatwadi through the
District Magistrate.
2. On 18-04-2019, discussion was m ade with the
com plainant and departm ental officials regarding the
investigation in the conference hall of District Magistrate
in Uttarkashi, in which the com plainant Sh. Jai Prakash
Pant and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate Tehsil Bhatwadi,
Dunda, Badkot and the other em ployees of the revenue
department were present. I n the presence of the
com plainant of case Sh. Prakash Pant, irregularities in
the distribution of relief aid to the affected people due to
floods in Bhagirathi river and Yam una river due to heavy
rain on 03/ 04-08-2012 and 16/ 17-06-2013 were
discussed. I n the presence of the com plainant
Sh.Prakash Pant, questions were asked from the officials
present at all the points. The records were shown
alongwith answering the questions related to the case.
Sh. Pant was given full opportunity to present his case
and to present the evidence to confirm his complaint.
No separate evidence was produced by him in relation
to any irregularity or com plaint.
3. Under the right to inform ation act 2005, the
com plainant Sh. Jai Prakash Pant, regarding providing
inform ation related to the distribution of m oney etc, to
the affected people due to flood in the Bhagirathi river
and Yam una river on 3/ 4-8-2012, during the

investigation, it was seen that the inform ation was
provided to them under the right to inform ation act
2005, on the basis of which they discussed, but they
were not aware of the certain governm ent orders. I f the
doubts of the complainant were not cleared by the
inform ation sought in the right to inform ation, then it
should have been rem oved. All the three Sub-Divisional
Magistrates and the Tehsildar were directed to provide
the inform ation sought by Sh. Pant, if he want to get
the inform ation by looking at the records, then do so. I n
this regard, the Tehsildar, Dunda apprised through the
Sub-Divisional Magistrate that till the date 13-05-2019,
no inform ation has been sought in the order of
instructions given by the com plainant during the
investigation, under the right to inform ation act 2005."
On such report being placed before
this Court, a Co-ordinate Bench of this
Court accepted the report on 09.10.2020.
Though, it is reflected that on 13.06.2018
the case was closed, however a date was
given. We do not find any reasons to
disagree with the findings recorded by the
Single Mem ber Com m ission, especially
when a Co-ordinate Bench has given an
opportunity to the learned counsel
appearing for the petitioner on 02.11.2020
and a copy was handed over, long back, to
him . He is unable to point out any
reasonable cause for not accepting the
report of the one m an com m ission.
I n that view of the m atter, we do not
find any reason to continue the writ-petition, in view of the report subm itted by
Mr. Senthil Pandian, I AS. Hence, the writ
petition is dropped.
The record of the inquiry com m ission
be rem itted back to the concerned
authority.
Urgent certified copy of this order be
supplied to the learned counsel for the
parties, as per r ule.
( R.C. Kh u lb e, J.) ( S.K. Mish r a, ACJ.)
06.04.2022
